_about: Skinned characters. All share one 22-bone skeleton and one animation set. 'player' is who you play. 'walk_anim_speed', 'brisk_anim_speed' and 'run_anim_speed' are the ground speeds (m/s) the Walk, Brisk (the Walk with a longer stride, used above a stroll) and Run loops' strides match for that body (tools/retarget_anims.py prints them); 'label_height' is where floating text sits above them. Everyone with a model plays with models made on tripo.ai from their turnarounds, put on their rigs by tools/rig_sculpt.py (Tripo's own UVs and texture, no re-bake). Their eyes are real (tools/add_eyes.py cuts the painted ones out and adds eyeballs, lids and lashes: the '_eyes' models, driven by scripts/face.gd); 'model_painted_eyes' is the model before that, and is used while the '_eyes' model hasn't been made yet (the NPCs Alex added on 2026-11-12: Barbara, Gary, Giorgio, Sabrina, Steve, and Wren's new model). Other bodies on the same rigs are kept for comparison (swap one into 'model' to try it): 'model_procedural' is the generated body from tools/build_character.py; Nora also has 'model_sculpt' from image-to-sculpt (too lumpy) and 'model_triposr' from TripoSR (tools/run_triposr.py; soft face up close).
